chunks: He said: Al-Sharif al-Zahid Abu Muhammad al-Hasan ibn Hamza reported to me from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Waleed, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Amru al-Afraq and Hudhaifa ibn Mansoor, that Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, said:
"The charity most beloved to God is bringing reconciliation among people when they have become divided by friction, and bringing them closer to each other when they have moved apart."

key_terms.إصلاح بين الناس: Reconciliation between people — restoring harmony after conflict
key_terms.تباعدوا: They moved apart — social and emotional distancing
key_terms.تفاسدوا: They became corrupt/divided — mutual friction and discord
key_terms.تقريب: Bringing closer — bridging distance between estranged parties
key_terms.صدقة: Charity (sadaqa) — voluntary giving for God's sake, broader than obligatory zakat

ai.seo_question: What is the most beloved charity to God according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) identifies the most beloved form of charity in God's eyes: reconciling people who have become estranged and bridging gaps between those who have grown distant. This teaching, narrated through multiple reliable transmitters, emphasizes that true charity extends beyond material giving to include social healing and peacemaking.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 10. He said: Al-Sharif al-Zahid Abu Muhammad al-Hasan ibn Hamza reported to me from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Waleed, from Muhammad.ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Amru al-Afraq and Hudhaifa ibn Mansoor that Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, said:
"The charity best loved by Allah is to bring about reconciliation among people when they are divided by friction and to bring them closer to each other when they have moved apart."
